Definition: properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be humble, be humbled, be subdued, be brought down, be low, be under, be brought into subjection; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to humble oneself; 1a2) to be humbled, be subdued; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to humble; 1b2) to subdue
